sloka: नाना विहग संकीर्णे रंस्यसे राम निर्वृतः ।ऋष्यमूकः तु पंपायाः पुरस्तात् पुष्पित द्रुमः ॥३-७३-३१॥
transliteration: nānā vihaga saṁkīrṇe raṁsyase rāma nirvṛtaḥ ।ṛṣyamūkaḥ tu paṁpāyāḥ purastāt puṣpita drumaḥ ॥3-73-31॥

translations.english: Mount Rishyamuka situated on the bank of Pampa has trees filled with blossoms. It is difficult to climb and is protected by young elephants.This lofty mountain was created by Brahma in olden days.
